proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellOptionRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The unit grants an existing spell through an existing magic-item activation shape, but the grant must be narrowed to only a closed subset of that spell's internal options. The current surface can override DC, area, targeting, and duration, but it cannot restrict the granted spell to specific allowed command words.

notes: The magic-item family fits otherwise: 7-charge pool, dawn recharge 1d6 + 1, fixed DC 15, and last-charge destruction all match the existing charged-wand pattern. Fear's 60-foot cone can be represented with areaOverride; Command's restricted options cannot.
